display_name: 原E200冻结：三种监督目标×两种条件输入的辅助难度学习
description: 仅L拟合6种独立辅助网络，V冻结评估，区分CE饱和监督与缺少决策状态；三个原E200种子，零身份更新
authorization: 持续84%目标的源域机制研究；上一轮源诊断已证明CE critic无可靠排序；只辅助拟合，后续身份训练仍独立40轮

code.commit: resolved from immutable Git release at launch

data.representation: equalized=1; center crop/pad 256; per-packet complex RMS; center=False; fs=25MHz

notes: Every auxiliary fit uses all8 cached candidate targets per sampled L packet; not an exact replay of prior online single-action critic.
PHYS and STATE parameter counts differ and will be reported. STATE consumes detached existing identity features/logits, not a second TX classifier.
V cyclic condition shuffle is fixed sensitivity check, not training augmentation or a new method.
All6 fits finish before V observation. Report every arm with both fixed selection rules; no epoch or temperature scan.
Success on this diagnostic does not prove84% clean performance; identity continuation requires separate fixed40epoch experiment.
